'''Arctic horny whelmers''' were beasts native to [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]]. They were famed as the design basis for the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> having the same immense bulk and squatting stance.
